def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    total=Counter(x for r in I for x in r)
    # try row sep first: a monochromatic full row whose color doesn't appear elsewhere or appears only as separator-like
    for i in range(H-1):
        r=I[i]
        if all(x==r[0] for x in r) and r[0]!=I[i+1][0]:
            # check no other cell of that color outside this row, or accept if neighbors differ enough
            others=sum(1 for rr in I[:i]+I[i+2:] for x in rr if x==r[0])
            if others<=H*W//3 or (others<H-1):
                A=I[:i]; B=I[i+1:]
                return [[2 if (A[r2][c]!=0) and (B[r2][c]!=0) else 0 for c in range(W)] for r2 in range(len(A))]
    for j in range(1,W-1):
        col=[I[r][j] for r in range(H)]
